unit: one offer-creation prefix; loss weighted equally per offer

target.meaning: recorded attribute; not certified equivalent to later O_Accepted or final loan outcome

prefix.order: original source order; require strictly increasing timezone-aware timestamps
prefix.max_length_policy: derive from full source audit; never discard long prefixes silently

split.boundary_rule: left closed, right open; equality enters the later interval
split.crossing_application_policy: exclude ALL offers of any application whose offer creation timestamps occupy more than one interval; retain excluded manifest
split.scope: retrospective chronological holdout; target maturity and historical feature availability not certified
split.date_provenance: July/September are new calendar engineering choices; 20 October follows EBES reference code. No model outcomes used. Not exact EBES reproduction.

features.availability: trace_static broadcast within prefix as retrospective benchmark convention; all other values only at their own event, no backward fill
features.numeric_zero: preserve as observed; CreditScore sentinel meaning unresolved
features.numeric_missing: explicit missingness indicator; zero placeholder after train-only standardisation
features.categorical_vocabulary: training-only observed categories, deterministic lexical order
features.numeric_statistics: population mean/std over observed values on unique TRAIN source events, not repeated offer-prefix occurrences; static trace values counted once per training application
features.numeric_scale: max(population_std, 1e-8); require at least one training observation; constant channels use scale 1.0; persist statistics and flags
features.time: elapsed time and preceding-event gap in seconds from source timestamps, gap zero at first event; absolute timestamp not model input; normalised time/gap/position follow frozen existing temporal encoder with training-only fitted scales
features.padding: dynamic right padding per batch; validity mask separate from missingness; preserve frozen attention masking

training_policy.batching: seeded offer shuffle, each admitted offer once per epoch, shared batch order across matched Transformer arms

evaluation.ece: MATH-08: 15 equal-width bins primary, 15 equal-mass bins sensitivity
evaluation.calibration: fit temperature only on clean calibration partition after model freezing; freeze temperature for test and corruption evaluation
evaluation.dummy: constant probability estimated from TRAIN class prevalence; held-out NLL and class metrics; no held-out prior fitting
evaluation.stratum_reporting: counts by label, NLL, balanced accuracy and per-class recall; undefined metrics explicitly NA; do not demand superiority to pass validity gates
evaluation.dependence: offers from one application are correlated; any observation-sampling bootstrap resamples applications with all their offers, not independent offers
evaluation.supplementary: application-macro NLL; state distinction from primary offer-weighted estimand

preflight: each split nonempty and contains both labels
all retained offers obey date interval
adapter_pending: train-only vocabularies/statistics with held-out perturbation tests
observed zero distinct from missing and padding
sufficient projection output dimension for semi-orthogonality
matched shared initialisation and identity/gamma-zero forward and shared-gradient parity
source_review_pending: exact official repository version and full terms
CreditScore zero semantics and historical field availability limitations documented
